tools.name: conversations_list
tools.description: Lists all channels in a Slack team; supports Slack's types mix and exclude_archived filters, which need more than column-equality (GET /conversations.list)

types.description: Mix and match channel types by providing a comma-separated list of any combination of public_channel, private_channel, mpim. Default: public_channel.

exclude_archived.description: Set to true to exclude archived channels from the list. Default: false.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 100.

tools.name: conversations_info
tools.description: Retrieve information about a conversation (GET /conversations.info)

channel.description: Conversation ID to learn more about, for example C0000001.

tools.name: conversations_history
tools.description: Fetches a conversation's history of messages and events; oldest/latest are Unix-timestamp range bounds, so this cannot use the equality-only list op (GET /conversations.history)

channel.description: Conversation ID (C…) or a #channel-name to fetch history for.

oldest.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp will be included in results. Default: 0.

latest.description: Only messages before this Unix timestamp will be included in results. Default: now.

inclusive.description: Include messages with oldest or latest timestamps in results. Ignored unless either timestamp is specified. Default: false.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 100.

tools.name: conversations_replies
tools.description: Retrieve a thread of messages posted to a conversation: the parent identified by ts plus every reply whose thread_ts points at it (GET /conversations.replies)

channel.description: Conversation ID (C…) or a #channel-name to fetch the thread from.

ts.description: Unique identifier of either a thread's parent message or a message in the thread, e.g. 1786312800.000101.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 100.

tools.name: conversations_members
tools.description: Retrieve members of a conversation (GET /conversations.members)

channel.description: ID of the conversation to retrieve members for, for example C0000001.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 30.

tools.name: conversations_join
tools.description: Joins an existing conversation as the workspace bot user; membership insert plus channel counters are server-side, not settable params (POST /conversations.join)

channel.description: Conversation ID (C…) or a #channel-name to resolve. The bot user U0000099 is added to the member list.

tools.name: conversations_invite
tools.description: Invites users to a channel; users is a comma-separated list that fans out to one membership row each, with users_not_found validation (POST /conversations.invite)

channel.description: The ID of the public or private channel to invite user(s) to.

users.description: A comma separated list of user IDs. Up to 1000 users may be listed, e.g. U0000001,U0000005.

tools.name: conversations_archive
tools.description: Archives a conversation; is_archived is set server-side and already_archived is rejected, so this is not a plain column update (POST /conversations.archive)

channel.description: ID of the conversation to archive.

tools.name: conversations_set_topic
tools.description: Sets the topic for a conversation (POST /conversations.setTopic)

channel.description: Conversation to set the topic of.

topic.description: The new topic string. Does not support formatting or linkification.

tools.name: conversations_set_purpose
tools.description: Sets the purpose for a conversation (POST /conversations.setPurpose)

channel.description: Conversation to set the purpose of.

tools.name: chat_post_message
tools.description: Sends a message to a channel as the workspace bot; the message ts is generated server-side and threaded replies bump the parent's reply_count (POST /chat.postMessage)

channel.description: Channel, private group, or IM channel to send message to. Can be an encoded ID (C…), or a name (#launch-room).

text.description: The formatted text of the message to be published.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's ts value to make this message a reply. Avoid using a reply's ts value; use its parent instead.

username.description: Set your bot's user name for this message. Defaults to ms-crm-agent.

tools.name: chat_update
tools.description: Updates a message in a channel; the message is addressed by the compound (channel, ts) key rather than a single-column ID (POST /chat.update)

channel.description: Channel containing the message to be updated. Can be an encoded ID, or a name.

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to be updated, e.g. 1786312800.000101.

tools.name: chat_delete
tools.description: Deletes a message from a channel, addressed by the compound (channel, ts) key (POST /chat.delete)

channel.description: Channel containing the message to be deleted. Can be an encoded ID, or a name.

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to be deleted.

tools.name: chat_schedule_message
tools.description: Schedules a message to be sent to a channel at a future Unix timestamp; returns the scheduled_message_id (POST /chat.scheduleMessage)

channel.description: Channel to send the message to, e.g. C0000001.

text.description: The formatted text of the message to be published.

post_at.description: Unix timestamp representing the future time the message should post to Slack.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's ts value to make this message a reply.

tools.name: users_list
tools.description: Lists all users in a Slack team, including bots and deactivated profiles (GET /users.list)

team_id.description: Encoded team id to list users in, e.g. T0000001.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 30.

tools.name: users_info
tools.description: Gets information about a user, including profile, presence, and admin flags (GET /users.info)

user.description: User to get info on, for example U0000001.

tools.name: users_lookup_by_email
tools.description: Find a user with an email address; returns users_not_found-style 404 when no profile matches (GET /users.lookupByEmail)

email.description: An email address belonging to a user in the workspace, e.g. contact77709@morganstanleysimulated.com.

tools.name: users_set_presence
tools.description: Manually sets user presence to auto, active, or away; targets the given workspace user (the real API acts on the authed user) (POST /users.setPresence)

user.description: User to set presence for, e.g. U0000003.

tools.name: reactions_add
tools.description: Adds a reaction (emoji) to a message; validates the (channel, timestamp) message exists and rejects already_reacted duplicates (POST /reactions.add)

channel.description: Channel where the message to add reaction to was posted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to add reaction to.

name.description: Reaction (emoji) name, without colons, e.g. thumbsup.

tools.name: reactions_remove
tools.description: Removes a reaction (emoji) from a message, addressed by the compound (channel, timestamp, name) key (POST /reactions.remove)

channel.description: Channel where the message to remove reaction from was posted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to remove reaction from.

name.description: Reaction (emoji) name, without colons, e.g. thumbsup.

tools.name: reactions_get
tools.description: Gets the reactions on a message identified by channel and timestamp (GET /reactions.get)

channel.description: Channel where the message was posted, e.g. C0000001.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to get reactions for, e.g. 1786312800.000101.

tools.name: pins_add
tools.description: Pins a message to a channel (POST /pins.add)

channel.description: Channel to pin the message to, e.g. C0000001.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to pin.

tools.name: pins_list
tools.description: Lists items pinned to a channel (GET /pins.list)

channel.description: Channel to get pinned items for, e.g. C0000001.

tools.name: pins_remove
tools.description: Un-pins an item from a channel, addressed by the compound (channel, timestamp) key (POST /pins.remove)

channel.description: Channel where the item is pinned to.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the pinned message to un-pin.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Searches for messages matching a query across message text in the workspace (GET /search.messages)

query.description: Search query. Matched case-insensitively as a substring of message text.

limit.description: The maximum number of matching messages to return. Default: 30.

tools.name: usergroups_list
tools.description: Lists all User Groups for a team, including handles, descriptions, and member counts (GET /usergroups.list)

team_id.description: Encoded team id to list user groups in, e.g. T0000001.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 30.

tools.name: usergroups_create
tools.description: Create a User Group; the S0-prefixed usergroup id is generated server-side (POST /usergroups.create)

name.description: A name for the User Group. Must be unique among User Groups.

handle.description: A mention handle. Must be unique among channels, users and User Groups.

description.description: A short description of the User Group.

tools.name: usergroups_update
tools.description: Update an existing User Group; only the fields provided are changed (POST /usergroups.update)

usergroup.description: The encoded ID of the User Group to update, e.g. S0000001.

name.description: A name for the User Group. Must be unique among User Groups.

handle.description: A mention handle. Must be unique among channels, users and User Groups.

description.description: A short description of the User Group.

tools.name: team_info
tools.description: Gets information about the current team, or another team on the same Enterprise Grid when team is given; the optional-id default is real API semantics, not a fallback row (GET /team.info)

team.description: Team to get info about; if omitted, will return information about the current (authed) team, T0000001.

tools.name: emoji_list
tools.description: Lists custom emoji for a team, including aliases and image URLs (GET /emoji.list)

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 30.
